title: Url generation from parameters
body:
For some integration like Magento, to load the instant search page with good params, the easiest way is to generate the (url) hash of the query and redirect to it. That way instantsearch will load on it's on.

Right now the url is hardcoded in the code which is not the cleaner way to do it.

A solution can be to instantiate a helper but that's not perfect to.
Adding this function to instantsearch could be useful

For a set of refinements like `{query: "madison}` or `[{query: "", refinements: ["category:Shirt"]}` the idea would be to generate something like `#q=madison&idx=...`

Also if this could be done without instantiating instantsearch it would be even better
